text: Sinndo wanaano Ɓural Alla ngal e dow mooɗon -onon yimɓe ɓen- e Yurmeende Makko nden e mooɗon, e wonndema kadi Kank ko O jaɓanoowo tuubuubuyee kala tuubuɗo immorde e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, ko O Ñeeño ka fewjoore Makko e ka Sari'a Makko O yaccinanayno on Lepte ɗen e dow bakkatuuji mo'on ɗin, O wirtirayno on sabu majji.
